0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000010_MERLWYB
0.description: Friends. 'Tis good to see you safe and well. I will admit, I had not counted on you seeking─let alone finding─refuge within the Holy See, but full glad was I to learn that you had.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000020_ALPHINAUD
1.description: Thankfully, we had allies there who took us under their wing. And theirs was not the only aid we received, I suspect.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000030_ALPHINAUD
2.description: When we fled Ul'dah, we fully expected to become wanted men, known to all and hounded at every turn. Yet that did not come to pass. On the contrary, 'twould seem the charges against us have not been made public. Might we have you to thank for that, Admiral?

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000040_MERLWYB
3.description: Sharp as ever, Master Alphinaud. On Marshal Tarupin's urging, the Elder Seedseer and I demanded that the Syndicate suppress news of the Scions' alleged crimes until such time as irrefutable evidence could be found.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000050_MERLWYB
4.description: Our argument was simple: lacking proof, to accuse the saviors of the realm of so unlikely a crime would have the people up in arms. In their wisdom, the Syndicate agreed, as you yourself have seen.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000060_MERLWYB
5.description: There is something you should know. Some few days prior to the banquet, the Elder Seedseer and I were summoned for a private audience with the sultana.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000070_MERLWYB
6.description: There, she revealed her intent to announce her abdication, that she might pave the way for the establishment of an Ul'dahn republic.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000080_ALPHINAUD
7.description: What? But such an announcement would have plunged the entire nation into chaos!

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000090_MERLWYB
8.description: She was well aware of that. 'Twas for fear of what might ensue that she summoned us. Her Grace wanted the Elder Seedseer and I to lend Raubahn a helping hand, you see─to aid him in preserving the peace during the transition.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000100_ALPHINAUD
9.description: So...having somehow caught wind of her plan, Lolorito and Teledji plotted the sultana's assassination in the hope of maintaining the constitutional status quo...?

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000110_ALPHINAUD
10.description: But they must have known that her death would sow as much chaos as her abdication─chaos from which Teledji alone might feasibly stand to profit. Surely Lolorito would never knowingly─

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000120_ALPHINAUD
11.description: Ah. Could it be...? I dare not hope...

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000130_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN
12.description: The Ul'dahn authorities have yet to announce the sultana's passing.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000140_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN
13.description: To allay any suspicion that may arise from Her Grace's absence, they have issued a statement to the effect that she is presently convalescing from illness.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000150_MERLWYB
14.description: Mayhap they're waiting for a fitting moment to break the news. Or mayhap they know of some other reason to delay.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000160_ALPHINAUD
15.description: Something else has been bothering me, Admiral. I was dismayed to learn that General Raubahn is to be executed─yet upon hearing the news, I could not help but wonder why he had been kept alive for so long.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000170_ALPHINAUD
16.description: Pray mistake not my meaning─I am, of course, overjoyed that our friend still draws breath, and that he might yet be saved. But if his enemies truly wished to eliminate him, they could have done so immediately. I see no reason for this delay.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000180_MERLWYB
17.description: Aye... You've struck upon an important point, Master Alphinaud.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000190_MERLWYB
18.description: Following his capture, Raubahn had been held in the Marasaja Pit within Ul'dah. In recent days, however, he has reportedly been moved to an unknown location.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000200_MERLWYB
19.description: Queerly, 'twas not the Brass Blades who spirited him away, either, but a band of soldiers decked in blue...

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000220_MERLWYB
21.description: Aye. If I read the winds aright, the arrangement between Lord Lolorito and the Braves has come under strain.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_000230_MERLWYB
22.description: At any rate, if we're to rescue Raubahn, we'll have to find him first. And you'll be glad to hear that I have already entrusted the task to those best able to see it done─our friends of Doma.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_100030_YUGIRI
25.description: Master Alphinaud. I am pleased to see that the light of resolve shines in your eyes once more.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_100040_ALPHINAUD
26.description: Ah, yes... How pathetic I must have seemed to you when we last met. I am ashamed to recall it. For a time I was well and truly lost. But with the aid of my comrades, I have since refound my purpose, and I shall take care not to misplace it again.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_100050_YUGIRI
27.description: Since your escape from Ul'dah, my fellow shinobi and I have shadowed the Crystal Braves' every step in hopes of learning the Scions' whereabouts.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_100060_YUGIRI
28.description: Regrettably, our investigation has yet to yield any useful information. Pray forgive us.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_100070_ALPHINAUD
29.description: You need not apologize, my lady─we are grateful for all that you have done on our behalf. Besides, Raubahn is no less a friend, and we cannot well abandon him to his fate.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_100080_YUGIRI
30.description: Hozan─the three of us shall attend to the Flame General's rescue. Pray draw away the guards by the entrance. Take Doware and Higiri with you.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_200020_ALPHINAUD
33.description: It is over, Ilberd! Lay down your arms and surrender yourself to justice!

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_200030_ILBERD
34.description: Justice!? Justice for what exactly? 'Twas not I who assassinated the sultana, boy!

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_200040_ALPHINAUD
35.description: Ere we debate who is responsible for the assassination, I would ask whether an assassination took place at all.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_200060_ILBERD
37.description: If you think you fight for justice, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>, you'd best wake up. The truth is, you fight for whoever bloody well tells you to. Can you not see you're being used!? By the Scions, the city<hex:021F0103>states, even the Crystal Braves. They none of 'em care a whit what you want─only what you can do for them.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_200070_ILBERD
38.description: And how do I know this? Because I'm the same─a pawn to be used as my masters see fit. All I ever wanted was to liberate my homeland, and I ate dirt to make it happen. But what have I achieved after all these years in servitude? Nothing! Not a bloody thing.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_200080_ILBERD
39.description: If we ourselves are not free─free to think and to act─how are we ever to reclaim our homeland? Know this: there is nothing I would not give to take back Ala Mhigo! NOTHING!

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_200100_YUGIRI
41.description: No, Master Alphinaud. Now is not the time.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_300010_RAUBAHN
42.description: I'm but a cripple and a fool, and still you came for me... I'm in your debt.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_300020_ALPHINAUD
43.description: We are all of us fools of fate, General. But even fools have a part to play.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_Q1_000_1
44.description: What will you say to Raubahn?

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_A1_000_2
46.description: On your feet, gladiator. This fight is not over.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_300030_RAUBAHN
47.description: Rest assured, I was not planning to die till I'd avenged the sultana... Still, your words are welcome, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_300040_RAUBAHN
48.description: Know this, Ilberd... There is nothing I would not give to see you pay for what you've done. My wealth, my arm, my life...nothing.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_300050_ALPHINAUD
49.description: General─are you aware that Lord Lolorito has yet to announce the sultana's death to the public?

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_300060_RAUBAHN
50.description: ...What? No. No, I was not aware of that─nor of anything else outside my cell. 'Tis passing strange, though... I assumed the bastard would make it known at the first opportunity and set about tearing down the sultanate.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_300070_ALPHINAUD
51.description: As did we all. And it is indeed strange that he did not─strange or perhaps revealing? Now, I have no conclusive proof, nor do I wish to give you false hope...but I have reason to believe that Her Grace may yet live.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_300080_RAUBAHN
52.description: What? But how can that be?

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_300090_YUGIRI
53.description: Forgive me, friends, but it is not safe here. Let us continue this conversation without.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400010_URIANGER
54.description: My dearest friends! Praise be unto the Twelve for delivering you from the clutches of treachery.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400030_RAUBAHN
56.description: Pipin, my son... And Master Papashan besides...

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400040_PIPPIN
57.description: Forgive me, Father... I should have been at Her Grace's side...

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400050_DEWLALA
58.description: (-???-)Save your tears. The sultana yet lives.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400070_DEWLALA
60.description: (-???-)It was I who arranged this gathering.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400080_DEWLALA
61.description: And judging by your perplexed expressions, it would seem introductions are in order. I am Dewlala, head of the Order of Nald'thal, and member of the Syndicate.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400090_RAUBAHN
62.description: What you said about the sultana─is it true? Is she alive?

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400100_DEWLALA
63.description: Young <hex:02080EE905FF056C616479FF046D616E03>─I understand you were with the sultana when she drank from the poisoned goblet and collapsed. Would I be correct in assuming that you did not personally verify Her Grace's vital signs?

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400110_RAUBAHN
64.description: Why ask, when 'tis plain you know the answer!

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400120_DEWLALA
65.description: Calm yourself, General, and let me finish. The truth is not as you imagine it. You are all victims of a most ingenious ruse─a ruse conceived to eliminate the threat posed by Teledji Adeledji.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400130_DEWLALA
66.description: 'Tis my belief that Teledji plotted the sultana's assassination alone, but that Lolorito caught wind of his plot, and exploited it to his own ends.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400140_DEWLALA
67.description: He sought to manipulate you into eliminating Teledji for him, and you duly obliged. At one fell swoop, he removed his two foremost rivals, all the while remaining above suspicion.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400150_RAUBAHN
68.description: Gods strike me down for a fool... But the sultana─how can it be that she lives?

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400160_DEWLALA
69.description: She lives because Lolorito willed it. Her own lady-in-waiting is but one of his many little birds; by her sleight of hand, the poison was switched for a less deadly draft before it could reach her mistress's lips.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400170_URIANGER
70.description: Some manner of sedative, perchance...of a potency sufficient to induce a slumber like unto death.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400180_DEWLALA
71.description: Were I to guess, I would say Her Grace is being held somewhere, dreaming dreams of a brighter Ul'dah, even as we speak.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400200_RAUBAHN
73.description: I will never forgive Lolorito for his part in this.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400210_DEWLALA
74.description: Though Lolorito's hands are far from clean, they did pluck Her Grace from the jaws of death. That must count for something.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400220_DEWLALA
75.description: And though one may call the man's methods into question, it cannot be denied that he knows the value of stability─to the very gil, like as not. He craves power, 'tis true, but he has no desire to depose the sultana.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400230_DEWLALA
76.description: I had never taken sides in your feud with the Monetarists, but it was not for want of concern for our nation's welfare. Indeed, 'twas out of the desire to see order restored that I furnished your Far Eastern friends with information, and arranged this gathering.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400240_DEWLALA
77.description: I hope you are ready to work, General, for there is much work to be done. Our first priority must be to bring matters back into balance. Lest you forget Her Grace's words, the true wealth of Ul'dah lies in the health, happiness, and hopes of her people.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400250_DEWLALA
78.description: As for the more worldly kind of wealth, I am content to let Lolorito help himself to whatever Teledji Adeledji left behind.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03002_400260_DEWLALA
79.description: You, meanwhile, must do that which you alone can do: rescue Her Grace and take your place at her side once more. For her sake...and that of our nation.
